title: Linear Baroclinic Prediction of Ocean Eddies
exact_target: Determine how much observed ocean-eddy structure can be explained by the linear instability of the mean ocean.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000579 (OWR-1325-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Theory and Modelling in Atmosphere-Ocean Science (2006), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2006/39, pp. 2307--2398; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 82--83, printed pages 2388--2389.

status_qualification: The source presents a null hypothesis and a model/data comparison program, not an exact equality or a universal prediction-error bound. The baseline mean state, observations, and meaning of largely predicted must be supplied in any quantitative follow-up.
